user.title: Choose your lights
user.description: Choose the lights, and whether they follow the circadian rhythm all day and night, or simply fade on to a set level before sunset. Light groups work too: each light in the group is handled on its own.

data_description.mode: Follow the circadian rhythm: lights that are on dim and warm through the evening. Fade on before sunset: lights switch on and brighten to a set level by sunset, and are otherwise left alone.

timing.title: Timing and ranges
timing.description: Fade-in: lights come on before sunset and are fully on by sunset. Circadian: from sunset (plus the offset) lights dim and warm over four hours to the night values, and come back up over an hour after sunrise.

data.fade_in: Also turn lights on before sunset

data_description.sunset_offset: Shift sunset earlier (negative) or later. The fade ends, and the evening wind-down starts, at this time.
data_description.transition_speed: How long each adjustment fades over: slow 5 min, moderate 3 min, fast 1 min.
data_description.fade_in: Lights that are off switch on at 1% and brighten to the curve's values by sunset. Once per evening; one you turn off stays off.
data_description.fade_in_minutes: How long before sunset (plus the offset) the fade starts. The lights are fully on at sunset.
data_description.fade_in_brightness: Where the fade ends. After that LumaFlow leaves the lights alone.
data_description.fade_in_color: White, or keep whatever colour each light was last set to.

data.enable_override_detection: Leave a light alone after it's changed by hand
data.restore_on_startup: Put lights back on the curve when Home Assistant starts

data_description.enable_override_detection: Until it's switched off and on again, restored with lumaflow.restore_lights, or midnight passes.

error.min_above_max: The night value must be below the day value.

enable.name: Enable
enable.description: Turn circadian lighting on for every LumaFlow entry.

disable.name: Disable
disable.description: Stop adjusting lights. Settings are kept.

restore_lights.name: Restore lights
restore_lights.description: Clear manual overrides and put lights straight back on the curve.

lights.name: Lights
lights.description: Only these lights. Leave empty for all of them.

override_lights.name: Override lights
override_lights.description: Set lights to your own values; LumaFlow leaves them alone until they're restored, switched off and on, or midnight.

rgb_color.name: RGB colour
rgb_color.description: Red, green and blue, 0 to 255 each.
